content: The ARTI description for a core class shall include a current task reference to the interpret the parameter value Description: A core class shall include a reference to a parameter definition that defines how a specific value of the current task parameter should be interpreted. Rationale: An ARTI consuming tool needs to know how to interpret the values for a current task, used by this implementation. Dependencies: [RS_Arti_00009] Use Case: Defining the display for current task. Supporting Material: -
